scope: Nine event captures from the real compiled game, plus mobile landscape and portrait.
findings: The three stage palettes match their sunset, moonlight and industrial settings.
Native bases meet the intended background platform; small emissions originate at the mechanism.
Foreground fighter silhouettes remain readable; no full-scene particle overlay or rectangular image backing appears.
All nine event captures were inspected individually. Actual cell and aspect-ratio observations are recorded separately in the browser proof.
Mobile controls and HUD stay inside both tested viewports; portrait intentionally letterboxes the widescreen combat scene.
limits: This verifies the three V66 sets, not visual completion of all 187 stages.
The locations and mechanisms are original game designs; exact canonical fidelity is not certified.
The overall portrait combat framing has large letterbox areas and is not claimed to be a redesigned mobile layout.
Public CDN and deployed browser verification remain separate gates.
